metadata.name: solana
metadata.description: zKube game program for Solana and MagicBlock

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

accounts.name: magic_fee_vault
docs: protocol infrastructure for gasless ER VRF and is unrelated to the
owner's base-layer player funding PDA.

accounts.name: player_state
docs: this unchecked prevents Anchor from serializing a stale outer copy over
the changes made by the self-CPI.

accounts.name: player_funding
docs: account is accepted; no retired program-owned layout is convertible.

fields.name: deadline_at
docs: Ranked and Practice actions and VRF callbacks are rejected at this
immutable cutoff. Campaign runs use zero (no cadence deadline).

fields.name: daily_score
docs: Arena leaderboard score: engine score plus pressure-scaled challenge bonus.

fields.name: daily_bonus_triggers
docs: Number of actions that earned nonzero Daily challenge bonus credit.

fields.name: arcade_metrics
docs: Canonical, full-width metrics used by the three Weekly boards.

fields.name: perfect_trigger_available
docs: Perfect-clear trigger may award at most once between player moves.

fields.name: perfect_clears
docs: Number of actual empty-board clears produced during this run.

fields.name: replay_hash
docs: Domain-separated rolling commitment over rules, VRF rows, and actions.

fields.name: profile_sync_mask
docs: Bit per payout-bearing Daily position. Profile synchronization happens
only after push settlement and cannot gate or repeat a transfer.

fields.name: period_kind
docs: 0 Daily, 1 Weekly, 2 Season.

fields.name: best_prize_rank
docs: Zero means no payout-bearing rank. Nonzero ranks are Daily/Season top
five or a Weekly board's top three only.

fields.name: bonus_multiplier_x100
docs: Raw objective points are scaled by this value before pressure.

fields.name: map_rules
docs: Rules that define one consistent identity across the whole map.

fields.name: active_run_id
docs: Zero when idle; otherwise the only run that may exist for this owner.
This durable pointer makes resume deterministic across devices and
prevents two valid device sessions from opening concurrent runs.

fields.name: active_run_daily
docs: Base-layer reservation remains authoritative while the run PDA is
delegated to an ephemeral rollup.

fields.name: orphan_run_id
docs: A deterministically expired run remains reserved until its delayed ER
copy is committed and the orphan account is closed.

fields.name: campaign_stars
docs: Two bits per level for exactly ten zones of ten levels. Campaign stars
are the sole progression source; all unlocks and badges are derived.

fields.name: featured_emblem
docs: Zero selects the strongest currently unlocked emblem automatically.

fields.name: lifetime_paid_entries
docs: Incremented exactly once by each successful owner-signed paid entry.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved bytes for a future explicitly versioned schema only.

fields.name: replay_domain
docs: Chain/deployment-specific replay domain used by canonical replay v2.

fields.name: campaign_map_count
docs: Number of contiguous, authority-activated Campaign maps.

fields.name: qualification_start_day
docs: First Daily eligible for this Season. The launch Season may start
mid-period; successor Seasons always use their natural Monday.

fields.name: profile_sync_mask
docs: Bit per payout-bearing Season position.

fields.name: qualification_start_day
docs: First Daily whose ranked runs can qualify for this Weekly. The launch
Weekly may start mid-period; all successors use the natural Monday.

fields.name: profile_sync_mask
docs: Nine bits: `board_index * 3 + zero_based_rank`.
